ModMetaData.name: Jarimichus Laser Cannon
ModMetaData.author: Jarimichu
ModMetaData.description:
A twin-barrelled defensive laser turret. It locks two continuous red beams onto the nearest hostile in sight and burns it, with a chance to set it alight. It holds fire while anyone friendly is on the line of fire.
Part of the Jarimichus series. Works on its own on grid power. With Jarimichus Beamwire installed, power beams can feed it too, and Beamwire's safety shutters can guard its line of fire. With Odyssey, its beams do half again as much damage in vacuum.
- Automatic, or manned by a colonist for +6 range and ×1.5 damage - Force target, clear target and hold fire controls - 18 damage per second (27 manned) with perfect accuracy; draws up to 1,000 W only while it has a target (50 W idle); the head swings back to rest when idle - On a gravship (Odyssey) it switches to a flush hull-mounted look that blends into the deck - Three art styles: Rim Standard, Hazard Industrial and Glitterworld Spacer, or follow Beamwire's choice - Research: Laser cannon (after Gun turrets and Microelectronics, hi-tech bench)\n\nIncludes a laser control console: link up to 3 Jarimichus lasers and man them all from one seat, for example inside a gravship.
